# Action reference

Every action a rule can take, with the parameters it accepts. Generated from the
handler declarations, which are also what validates a saved rule and what renders
the form in the editor -- one definition, three consumers.

String parameters support `{placeholder}` substitution from the matched torrent:
`{name}`, `{category}`, `{hash}`, `{save_path}`, `{content_path}`, `{state}`,
`{source_name}` and `{tags}`. An unknown placeholder fails the action rather than
writing a literal brace into a path.

## `category.set` -- Set category

Sets the qBittorrent category on matched torrents.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `category` | string | *required* | Category name; blank clears it |
| `enable_auto_management` | boolean | `True` | Turn on qBittorrent's automatic torrent management so it relocates the files into the category's save path. |

## `script.run` -- Run script

Runs a command on the qbitflow host. Disabled unless QBITFLOW_ENABLE_SCRIPT_ACTION is set.

**Opt-in.** Disabled unless `QBITFLOW_ENABLE_SCRIPT_ACTION` is set on the
container. It executes commands on the qbitflow host.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `command` | string | *required* | Command line to run. Split with shell-style quoting and executed directly, never through a shell. Placeholders like {name} are substituted first. |
| `working_dir` | string | `''` | Directory to run in; must already exist |
| `timeout_seconds` | integer | `300` | Kill the command if it has not finished in this many seconds |
| `run_once_per_torrent` | boolean | `True` | Record a marker so the command runs at most once per torrent per rule. |

## `seeding.forceStart` -- Force start

Turns qBittorrent's force-start flag on or off.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `on` | boolean | `True` | Whether force-start should be on |

## `seeding.start` -- Start seeding

Resumes paused torrents.

No parameters.

## `seeding.stop` -- Stop seeding

Pauses running torrents.

No parameters.

## `speed.limit` -- Limit speed

Sets per-torrent upload and download limits.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `upload_kib` | integer | `-1` | Upload limit in KiB/s. 0 is unlimited, -1 leaves it unchanged. |
| `download_kib` | integer | `-1` | Download limit in KiB/s. 0 is unlimited, -1 leaves it unchanged. |
| `pause_when_both_zero` | boolean | `False` | Legacy behaviour: treat both limits being zero as a request to pause. Off by default because 'unlimited' and 'paused' are not the same thing. |

## `tag.add` -- Add tag

Adds a tag to matched torrents.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tag` | string | *required* | Tag name |

## `tag.remove` -- Remove tag

Removes a tag from matched torrents.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tag` | string | *required* | Tag name |

## `tag.sync` -- Sync tag

Adds the tag to torrents the rule matches and removes it from torrents it no longer matches, so the tag always reflects the rule.

**Bidirectional.** It also runs against torrents the rule *stops* matching,
undoing itself. That is what makes the state converge on the rule.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tag` | string | *required* | Tag name |

## `torrent.export` -- Export .torrent

Saves the .torrent file to disk.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `folder` | string | `''` | Destination folder; defaults to the exports volume |

## `torrent.move` -- Move torrent

Changes a torrent's save location, moving its data.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | string | *required* | Destination directory |
| `verify_path_exists` | boolean | `True` | Check the directory exists before moving. This checks *this* container's filesystem, which is only meaningful when it sees the same paths as qBittorrent -- turn it off if they differ. |
